## [0.6.8] - 2026-09-05

### Changed

- Turn the Wallets "Devices per attendee" card into a two-ring donut that also shows the device-registration total ([#1250](https://github.com/solarssk/admitto/pull/1250))

### Fixed

- Log a `mail_test_send_failed` entry in System logs when a template test send fails ([#1248](https://github.com/solarssk/admitto/pull/1248))

---

### Deploy
- Container image: `ghcr.io/solarssk/admitto:0.6.8` (rolling `:0.6`)
- Migrations apply **automatically on container start**. **No manual `migrate deploy`.** Back up the database yourself before upgrading (the stack no longer takes an automatic pre-migration backup).

[Full changelog](https://github.com/solarssk/admitto/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
